Thanks Samir — that works. We can split into a 75-minute workshop + 45-minute load-test window the same afternoon to reduce context switching for your ops team. Quick answers:
- Target: for the load run we can provision to simulate ~12 concurrent streams (~6–8 tokens/sec per stream), so roughly 100–200 tokens/sec aggregate depending on prompt length. Dev will tune batching and KV caching to keep latency under 250ms p95 where possible.
- PHI: we can enable request-level redact hooks and audit logging. I’ll loop in our security docs and we can do a brief checklist during the kickoff.

Proposed combined schedule (PST):
• Wed 2026-03-24 13:30–15:30 — 13:30–14:45 workshop; 14:45–15:30 load test and ops review

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the final agenda. Dev — please confirm the load parameters below and paste any prep notes for BrightGrid.

Best,
Marissa

Hi all — quick tech notes for the load test and prep checklist:
- We’ll run a 45-minute test starting at 14:45 PST. Plan: ramp from 1x -> 12x concurrent streams over 5 minutes, hold for 30 minutes, then cool down.
- Token guidance: use the sanitized prompt length you shared (~120 tokens avg). With 12 streams at 8 tokens/sec average that’s ~960 tokens/sec peak. If BrightGrid expects longer contexts (400–800 tokens) we’ll see higher aggregate token/sec — let us know so we can allocate extra capacity.
- Routing: please indicate in your CSV the routing label (e.g., payments, support, hr) so I can pre-configure route variants. If you want sticky routing we’ll run with a KV cache TTL of 30m for the test.
- Security: Marissa will share the checklist. For VPN — we do not require it; audit logs and KMS-backed keys are available for Private deployments.

Drive link to the prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-poc-materials
